title: BC Test Catalog
description: Schema for catalog.json — a 3-level hierarchy (Waardeketen > Type > Procesflow) that organises BC workflow test projects into a traceable structure.

$schema.description: Optional: reference to this schema file for VS Code IntelliSense.

value_chains.description: Top-level grouping of business processes (e.g. Projecten, Service). Each value chain contains one or more types.

value_chain.description: Level 1 — a business value chain (waardeketen). Groups related project types.

code.description: User-defined short code (uppercase, max 10 chars). Used as prefix in composite codes.

name.description: Display name for this value chain.

description.description: Optional description of this value chain.

types.description: Project types within this value chain (e.g. Termijnmotivering, Regie).

type.description: Level 2 — a project type within a value chain. Groups related process flows.

code.description: User-defined short code (uppercase, max 10 chars). Combined with parent: PRJ-TM.

process_flows.description: Process flows (test workflows) within this type.

process_flow.description: Level 3 — a single process flow that maps 1:1 to a workflow folder containing workflow.json.

code.description: User-defined short code (uppercase, max 10 chars). Full composite code: PRJ-TM-PO-APPR.

name.description: Display name for this process flow.

description.description: Optional description of what this process flow tests.

workflow_path.description: Relative path (from catalog.json location) to the workflow project folder. Must contain a workflow.json.
